title: Flowra in 2 minutes: find the pages losing traffic, fix them, prove it worked
description:
Your best page still ranks fourth on Google, same as last year. So where did the clicks go?

Search changed, and decay doesn't crash. It slides a few percent a month, and nothing is watching. Flowra is the whole content loop in one place: it finds the pages slipping, plans the fix, publishes it to WordPress and comes back to measure whether it worked.

Free to start, no card: https://useflowra.com?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch-film

Chapters
0:00 Your ranking held. Your traffic didn't.
0:30 This is Flowra, and the two-minute setup
0:52 Every page, worst first, and why
1:03 A plan you can argue with
1:17 Publish to WordPress

1:44 Weekly reports, and six more tools
1:55 Find the loss. Fix the page. Prove it worked.

What you saw:
- Search Console and GA4 in one dashboard, with 16 months of history
- Content decay: the pages losing clicks and impressions, worst first, with the reason
- The Rework Queue: a section-by-section plan against the pages beating you; anything you don't approve comes back word for word
- Publishing to WordPress, and a recrawl request to Google when you publish
- Measure a change: a before-and-after comparison with a 14 day settling window, adjusted for the whole site's movement
- A client report that rebuilds itself every week, with your logo

Every number in the video is example data.
